summary: This is a Docker Compose configuration that defines an Apache web server service. It builds the service from the current directory, exposes port 80, and mounts the local src folder into Apache's document root so that changes to your source code are immediately visible in the container.

explanations.6: The syntax '%%port=80%%:80' appears to be a template variable that will be replaced with an actual port number at runtime; the second 80 is the port inside the container that Apache listens on.
explanations.8: This line maps your local ./src directory into the container at /usr/local/apache2/htdocs, which is where Apache looks for website files to serve.
